android._adaptiveIcon: The three android-icon-*.png files in assets/ are Expo's template defaults — a blue chevron, not this product. Pointing the launcher at them would ship somebody else's mark. Until a foreground is drawn with the adaptive safe zone in mind (Android masks the outer third, which would cut the wordmark off this artwork), Android falls back to `icon` above, which is the real one.
